usedFor: Slide holds contacts and orders, Instagram for Business publishes, and “When an order is fulfilled” can run “Publish Instagram Story”.

bestTemplate.name: “When an order is fulfilled” in Slide, then “Publish Instagram Story” in Instagram for Business
bestTemplate.why: A fulfilled order can become a Story built from a public photo or video URL.

watchOut: “Publish Instagram Story” takes a photo or video from a public URL, so the trigger has to supply one.
